sources.title: Spearman Rank Correlation: Definition & Calculation (2026)
sources.snippet: Spearman Rank Correlation, denoted ρ (rho), is a nonparametric statistic that measures the strength and direction of the monotonic relationship between two variables. Rather than working with raw data values, it converts both variables to ranks, then assesses whether those ranks move together. There are three commonly used Pearson correlation coefficients (total, between-, and within-cluster), which together provide an enriched perspective of the correlation.
